name: lossik/mikrotik-ssh
description: MikroTik RouterOS client over SSH and SFTP (phpseclib 2)

ignore.CVE-2026-84308: Not applicable to this package (GHSA-q97c-8qh3-fpc6): exploitation requires a reused X25519 private key, and per the advisory phpseclib's own SSH path generates a fresh scalar per exchange and is not affected. This package uses phpseclib only for SSH and SFTP.
